findings.title: At branding version 0 every Arabic export prints the English product name 'Mobily Transformation Hub' in its header, while the API and the Arabic shell use the version-0 Arabic name 'منصة موبايلي للتحوّل'
findings.reproduction: On a fresh database with no branding_setting row (version 0), generate any report and export it in Arabic (here: the A15 matrix of tests/qa/integration/a15-outputs-every-definition.test.ts run alone with QA_A15_DUMP, then my inspection 11-inspect-samples.log). All 25 Arabic PDF, DOCX and PPTX files (12 + 8 + 5) start with the header text 'Mobily Transformation Hub'. Cause: apps/worker/src/reports/export-runner.ts:379-381 passes `productName: deps.productName ?? DEFAULTS.productName` when brandingAtGeneration returns null, for every language; DEFAULTS.productName (packages/shared/src/constants.ts:61) is the English text only. After a branding version is saved, the runner uses productNameAr for Arabic (branding.test.ts asserts that case), so only version 0 is affected.
findings.expected: ADR-0049 §8 'Version 0 is the default': 'the name "Mobily Transformation Hub" / "منصة موبايلي للتحوّل" (the shipped i18n texts)'; GET /api/v1/branding at version 0 returns productNameAr 'منصة موبايلي للتحوّل' (apps/api/src/modules/admin/branding-port.ts:19, asserted by branding.test.ts 'version 0'), and the Arabic shell shows it (common.brand.productName). An Arabic export at version 0 should carry the same Arabic name in its header (CLAUDE.md: Arabic RTL for every user-facing string; REQ-S13-009 bilingual exports).
findings.actual: The Arabic file headers carry the English default name at version 0, so the screen and the generated output of the same organization show different product names in Arabic. The literal acceptance of REQ-S01-002 ('a fresh install shows "Mobily Transformation Hub"'; a changed name reaches the next report header in en and ar) still holds, and no number, approval or authorization is affected: cosmetic bilingual inconsistency, Low.
